pages.useful_because: The homepage is the one place a Sherman or Denison buyer sees HARDROCK's whole offer at once: the eight bulk materials and the four kinds of site work (driveways, house pads, ponds, land clearing) under one company, the actual opening hours (6 AM weekday start, Saturday 9-2), real photos of HARDROCK jobs such as rip rap set over filter fabric and a pond basin dug between trees, the cubic-yard math for sizing an order, a plain guide to which material suits which job, and the live Google reviews. Every service page goes deep on one item; this page is where a customer works out which one they need and calls.
